This setting is not active in the current Bandits mod, so spawning is even across the map whatever you set here.
Allow the Bandits mod's own gangs to spawn
On means the Bandits mod spawns the 36 gangs it ships with. Off leaves only bandits placed by you or by other mods.

How often bandit gunfire hits you. Melee is not affected. Every bandit gets the level you pick. Varies by gang keeps the Bandits mod's own mix. Higher settings also fit them better scopes, so a more accurate bandit opens fire from further away. Only affects bandits that spawn after this setting is changed.
Seconds Before They Fire, Up Close
How long you get between a bandit deciding to shoot and the shot arriving, when it is within 2 tiles of you.
Seconds Before They Fire, At Range
How long you get between a bandit deciding to shoot and the shot arriving, when it is 6 tiles or more away from you.
Allows gangs that come looking for you and attack on sight. 17 gangs can assault. Turning this off removes assaults only, so gangs with other roles can still appear.
Allows gangs to set up forest camps. 7 gangs can camp, and this is the only way camps appear for you to loot. Turning this off removes camping only, so gangs with other roles can still appear.

Turn this off to stop survivors joining you unasked. Four gangs skip the asking and turn up already walking with you: the karate class, the officers, the army deserters, and the wedding party. Gangs with other roles can still appear.

Allows bandits to spawn already inside buildings for you to encounter when you enter. 10 gangs can defend buildings. Turning this off removes building defence only, so gangs with other roles can still appear.
Allows gangs to set up roadblocks. 6 gangs can do this. Turning this off removes roadblocks only, so gangs with other roles can still appear.

Allows wandering gangs to roam Knox Country. 18 gangs wander. Only 4 are friendly, and those 4 are the only survivors you can recruit to travel with you. Turning this off removes wandering only, so gangs with other roles can still appear.
Gives you a break after an assault gang arrives. No other assault can happen for a number of days picked at random from the range you choose. Gangs with other roles can still appear.
Limits which gangs the CB radio reports, without changing which gangs spawn. Players can still hide either side in their own radio settings.
Off leaves the Bandits mod exactly as it is and keeps only this mod's CB radio. Use it alongside another mod that already changes how bandits spawn, fight, or die.
Hours Before a Bandit Body Disappears, 0 for the Same as Zombies

How many in-game hours a dead bandit lies there before its body is cleared. At 0, bandit bodies go when zombie bodies go, using the game's own Time Before Corpse Removal setting. Bodies are cleared only while a player is nearby.
Master switch. Off means this mod does nothing and the Bandits mod carries on as normal.

There are 29 hostile gangs and 7 friendly gangs. Hostile gangs shoot on sight. Friendly gangs leave you alone unless attacked first. This setting decides which gangs can appear. Hostile only means no friendly gangs or companions. Friendly only means no hostile gangs, so no bandits will hunt you down.
The Bandits mod releases its 36 gangs gradually, from day 0 to day 365. This pushes that whole schedule back by the number of days you set. At 30, a gang due on day 100 turns up on day 130 instead.

Caps how many people a friendly gang can spawn. The default does not limit normal friendly gangs, whose largest usual size is 14. It only starts to matter if the Bandits spawn multiplier is raised above 1.
Caps how many people a hostile gang can spawn. The default does not limit any hostile gang, whose largest size is 16. Set it below 16 to make hostile gangs smaller.
Stops new bandits appearing while this is turned on. Existing bandits are unaffected, and spawning resumes when you turn it off.
Players get this frequency as a preset on every radio they open, so nobody has to be told the number. Enter MHz from 88.0 to 108.0 in steps of 0.2, or 0 for none. Anything else is ignored.
Another CB radio frequency, or 0 for none. Same rules as CB Radio Frequency 1.
Another CB radio frequency, or 0 for none. Same rules as CB Radio Frequency 1.
Another CB radio frequency, or 0 for none. Same rules as CB Radio Frequency 1.
Only on a radio, within its range

Decides whether players need a radio to hear gang broadcasts. Heard anywhere needs no radio. Only on a radio needs a powered radio that is on and tuned to a CB frequency, carried or within 15 tiles. Within its range also needs the gang to be inside that radio's range. Gang arrivals are broadcast only while "Icon marker leading to bandit spawn point" is on, on the Bandits General page.
The furthest away a bandit will open fire with a pistol or revolver, in tiles, regardless of what is fitted to the gun.
The furthest away a bandit will open fire with a rifle, in tiles, regardless of what is fitted to the gun.
The furthest away a bandit will open fire with a shotgun, in tiles, regardless of what is fitted to the gun.
On, a dead bandit keeps the clothes, weapons, and bag it had, with one bag instead of two. Off leaves bodies as the Bandits mod makes them, for use with another mod that fixes bodies.

How long a bandit can chase and fight before tiring. Below Normal they tire quickly and you get a chance to break away. Every bandit gets the level you pick. Varies by gang keeps the Bandits mod's own mix. Only affects bandits that spawn after this setting is changed.

How much damage a bandit can take, compared with an ordinary zombie: Frail 1.0 times as much, Soft 1.4, Normal 1.8, Tough 2.2, and Hardened 2.6. Every bandit gets the level you pick. Varies by gang keeps the Bandits mod's own mix, where most gangs sit at 1.8 and the toughest reach 2.6. Only affects bandits that spawn after this setting is changed.
